title: agrostis canina var. nivea
intro: Agrostis canina var. nivea, commonly known as Snowy Bent or White Bent, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, which can contribute to better sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Snowy Bent include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Snowy Bent include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
